reviews.justification: A is the Graves initial-management umbrella; B selects antithyroid drugs, one option inside that management decision.
Describing lesion morphology and reasoning from morphology to a differential require different knowledge and are separately scoreable.
A recognizes PID only; B spans recognition and management of PID.
Recognizing an oncologic emergency and initiating apheresis are independently scoreable; the umbrella names recognition, not therapy.
A is the anorectal-abscess management umbrella; urgent incision and drainage is one action inside it.
Troponin and chest radiography are different investigation pathways requiring different knowledge, not one decision with two wordings.
Applying diagnostic criteria and counselling on risk reduction are separate scoreable decisions.
Both rows are the single decision of staging labour; B is only the umbrella wording of A.
Recognizing ankylosing spondylitis includes, and extends beyond, separating inflammatory from mechanical back pain.
A is the specific referral-trigger recognition inside B's broader vascular-lesion recognition umbrella.
A is the concussion counselling umbrella; graduated return-to-activity counselling sits inside it.
Choosing investigations and generating a differential for chest pain are different reasoning targets.
Both rows are the one decision of selecting first-line smoking-cessation pharmacotherapy; B is a broken fragment of the same option list.
Separating glomerular from non-glomerular haematuria is one step inside B's general haematuria assessment.
Severity triage and differential generation are separately scoreable respiratory decisions.
Recognizing hiatus hernia and identifying surgical-repair indications require different knowledge; the umbrella names recognition only.
Duration-and-course separation from other psychotic disorders is one component of B's schizophrenia diagnosis umbrella.
Both rows state the single decision to screen for organic causes before attributing new psychosis to primary psychiatric illness.
A is the syphilis diagnosis umbrella; B is the specific staged serologic diagnosis inside it.
A covers recognition of one entity; B is the diagnosis umbrella for the whole immunocompromised-host unit.
Both rows are the single decision of interpreting standard population mortality measures.
Arterial blood gas and electrocardiography are different investigation pathways with different indications.
Both rows are the single duration-based separation of brief psychotic disorder from schizophreniform disorder and schizophrenia.
Diagnosing prolapse and identifying its contributing risk factors are separately scoreable.
B is the bare generic management heading for generalized anxiety disorder and contains A's first-line initiation decision.
reviews.relation_note: Reviewer rule applied consistently from batch 2 onward: a bare generic category wrapper is a heading and yields containment, not equivalence.
